english.title: Contravene / fail to comply with specified Community provision re food hygiene in Wales
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) contravened or failed to comply with a specified Community provision listed in Schedule 2 to the Food Hygiene (Wales) Regulations, namely **(..SPECIFY PROVISION..) in that **(..SPECIFY NATURE OF CONTRAVENTION OR FAILURE TO COMPLY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 17(1) and 17(2) of and Schedule 2 to the Food Hygiene (Wales) Regulations 2006.
english.pointstoprove:

english.notes: A "specified Community provision" ("darpariaeth Gymunedol benodedig") means any provision of the Community Regulations that is specified in column 1 of Schedule 2 to the Food Hygiene (Wales) Regulations 2006 and whose subject-matter is described in column 2 of that Schedule.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Two Years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
No prosecution for an offence under these Regulations which is punishable under paragraph (2) of regulation 17 may be begun after the expiry of (a) three years from the commission of the offence; or (b) one year from its discovery by the prosecutor, whichever is the earlier.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
